access_warning: Shared root has anyone:writer. Inherited child folders also have anyone:writer. Do not put confidential HR, attendance photos, payroll, contracts, personal records or tokens here until a verified restricted storage destination is configured.
do_not_assume_live_app_routing: These folders exist in Drive; no storage route registry entries, Vercel variables, migrations or application identity OAuth permissions have been changed.

routing_policy.database: Google Drive is the primary file-byte and recoverable raw/snapshot store; Supabase stores file metadata and minimal transactional application state for shift, staffing, audit and payroll consistency, not binary file payloads.
routing_policy.operational_assets: All NEW app file bytes and datasets go into 00_ADA_OPS_PLATFORM domain-first folders, by exact verified folder ID. No parallel Brand/Platform root tree outside the approved new app root.
routing_policy.report_assets: All NEW app-generated report assets must be written under 00_ADA_OPS_PLATFORM/03_LIVE_REPORTS, dynamically organized by Brand ID, Platform ID, YYYY/MM, stable parent shift UUID and nine evidence subfolders. Older Brand LS Report folders under LIVESTREAM REPORT are LEGACY READ-ONLY sources for prior assets; do not silently reuse them for new writes.
routing_policy.private_data: HR and Finance directories have been created, but inherit anyone:writer and are not private; use for structure only until approved restricted root or reviewed ACL policy supports sensitive data.
routing_policy.idempotency: Resolve by actual parent folder ID plus exact name, verify provider metadata; do not create duplicates by loose name match.
routing_policy.no_secrets: Do not write bearer tokens, refresh tokens, service-role keys, payroll details or authentication cookies into shared root.
routing_policy.supersedes_prior_report_roots: Owner 2026-11-02: all NEW app files to 00_ADA_OPS_PLATFORM, not historical Brand LS Report folders. Historical files remain readable.
